scripts.validate: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @beartrace/cli run validate
scripts.validate:examples: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @beartrace/cli run validate:examples
scripts.build:projection: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @beartrace/cli run build:projection
scripts.build:projection:examples: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @beartrace/cli run build:projection:examples
scripts.prepare:dashboard:examples: pnpm run build:projection:examples && pnpm --filter @beartrace/encryption exec node dist/cli.js --in ../../dist/projection.examples.json --out ../../apps/dashboard/public/dashboard.enc.json
